title: Encoding complex-balanced thermalization in quantum circuits
summary: Non-Markovian dynamics in open quantum systems often invalidates the complex-balanced thermalization framework, hindering predictive control of quantum simulation platforms designed to prepare out-of-equilibrium states at prescribed temperatures. We resolve this bottleneck by engineering reservoir qubits as modular microscopic units coupled to a target quantum system and constructing a quantum-circuit platform that enforces strictly Markovian complex-balanced thermalization.
